Run Core Imprintome Analysis

Source: R/ImprintomeSet-run.R
runImprintome.Rd

User-facing entry point for running the core IDS/Angle/mechanism workflow on an ImprintomeSet object using existing AnalyzeImprintStatus() logic.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'ImprintomeSet'
runImprintome(
  x,
  probeset = "selected",
  ids_cutoff = 0.2,
  result_name = NULL,
  dmr_type = NULL,
  reference = c("auto", "controls", "fixed"),
  reference_group = NULL,
  reference_samples = NULL,
  reference_beta = NULL,
  infinium_type = c("all", "I", "II", "balanced"),
  balance = c("probe", "icr"),
  min_probes = 3L,
  icr = FALSE,
  delta_cutoff = 0.175,
  z_cutoff = 2,
  n_boot = 0L,
  n_perm = 0L,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  resample = c("icr", "probe"),
  permute = c("icr", "probe"),
  resample_reference = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An ImprintomeSet object.

probeset

Character scalar probeset name (for example, "selected").

ids_cutoff

Numeric IDS cutoff passed to AnalyzeImprintStatus().

result_name

Optional name for storing output in results(x).

dmr_type

DMR_type selection passed to AnalyzeImprintStatus(). NULL (default) uses the panel default: gametic ICRs only for the core selected panel, all probes for other panels. Use "all" for all probes or, for example, "secondary" to score secondary DMRs separately. An explicit value is added to the default result name (for example AnalyzeImprintStatus.selected.all); the dmr_type column of the result records the selection applied.

reference, reference_group, reference_samples, reference_beta

Reference centring options passed to AnalyzeImprintStatus(). By default ("auto"), external controls (reference_beta) or in-cohort controls (reference_group/reference_samples) are used when supplied, and the fixed 0.5 reference only when no controls are available.

infinium_type

Infinium design types to score ("all", "I", "II" or "balanced"), passed to AnalyzeImprintStatus().

balance

"probe" (default) or "icr" for the ICR-balanced sample-level IDS/Angle, passed to AnalyzeImprintStatus(); "icr" adds .icr to the default result name.

min_probes

Minimum probes per ICR for ICR-balanced and per-ICR scoring (default 3).

icr

Logical. If TRUE, also score each ICR with AnalyzeICRStatus() (all annotated ICRs, with the same reference) and store the per-ICR table as ICRStatus.<probeset> and its per-sample multi-locus summary (SummarizeICRStatus()) as ICRSummary.<probeset>.

delta_cutoff, z_cutoff

Thresholds for altered-ICR calls, passed to AnalyzeICRStatus() when icr = TRUE (defaults 0.175 and 2).

n_boot, n_perm, conf_level, resample, permute, resample_reference, seed

Bootstrap uncertainty intervals and permutation null for IDS and Angle, passed to AnalyzeImprintStatus() (off by default; see its Uncertainty section). The added columns record the settings; result names are unchanged. The permutation p-value is interpretable only with a control reference.

...

Reserved for future compatibility.

Value

Updated ImprintomeSet object with analysis table stored in results(x).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
beta_mat <- matrix(runif(200), nrow = 20)
rownames(beta_mat) <- paste0("cg", sprintf("%08d", seq_len(20)))
colnames(beta_mat) <- c("S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6", "S7", "S8", "S9", "S10")

meta_df <- data.frame(
  Sample_Name = colnames(beta_mat),
  Sample_Group = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 5),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

probeset_df <- data.frame(
  NAME = rownames(beta_mat),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

x <- ImprintomeSet(
  beta = beta_mat,
  meta = meta_df,
  probeset = probeset_df,
  genome = "hg19",
  assay = "EPICv1"
)

x <- runImprintome(x, probeset = "selected", ids_cutoff = 0.2)
head(results(x)[["AnalyzeImprintStatus.selected"]])
} # }
